sections.installation:
Prerequisites

  • WordPress version 6.0 or higher
  • WooCommerce plugin must be installed and activated

Method 1: WordPress Admin Dashboard (Recommended)

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Log into your WordPress admin dashboard
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  4. Click Upload Plugin
  5. Choose the downloaded zip file
  6. Click Install Now
  7. Click Activate Plugin

Method 2: Manual Installation

  1. Download and extract the plugin zip file
  2. Upload the “wt-for-woocommerce” folder to /wp-content/plugins/ directory via FTP
  3. Go to Plugins in WordPress admin
  4. Find “wetracked.io for WooCommerce” and click Activate

Configuration

  1. Navigate to WP Admin > wetracked.io
  2. Enter the API key from your wetracked.io account
  3. Click “Verify and save”

Verification

  • If the API key is valid, you will see a success message. If not, you will see an error message.
  • No additional setup required – the plugin automatically starts tracking once configured
  • Check your wetracked.io dashboard to confirm data is flowing

Cookie Consent

  • The plugin is compatible with WP Consent API plugins and it’s loaded only when the cookie consent plugin is accepted.
  • If no cookie consent plugin is active, the plugin is loaded on every page.

Support

If you have any questions or issues, please contact us https://help.wetracked.io/en/
